records.finding: Virtual DAPI has bright, partly confluent peaks in a compact cell cluster. Some peaks overlap independently outlined nuclei, but AUC 0.690 and contrast 0.034 fail the frozen nuclear gate.

Virtual-DAPI peaks often correspond to sparse StarDist nuclei and automatic nuclear, spatial and seam checks pass; no obvious rectangular shadow at contact-sheet scale. All 23 channels were inspected. Many displayed proteins share bright nuclear morphology: 34% of native marker pairs have within-nucleus Spearman rho above 0.8, and the pairwise median is 0.546. Biological marker specificity and full-resolution shadow absence remain unverified.

publication_limit: The one technical pass is not yet a validated cell-type test image. No score or public gallery was updated from this partial cohort.
